nodes.description: Public token name string '0xBTCHate'.
Public token symbol '0xBTCHate'.
Public token decimals value 18.
Public mapping(address=>uint256) of balances; mutated in IHate0xBTC, transfer and transferFrom.
Public nested mapping(address=>address=>uint256) of spending approvals.
Public mapping(uint=>bool) marking keccak256 hashes of reasons already claimed.
Public total supply counter, increased by 10**18 per new hate claim.
Public mining function: hashes reason, mints 10**18 tokens to msg.sender when the hash is unused, emits 100 fake Transfer events and increments totalSupply.
Public ERC20 transfer guarded by validAddress modifier; moves _value from msg.sender to _to.
Public ERC20 transferFrom guarded by validAddress modifier; moves _value from _from to _to using allowance.
Public approve guarded by validAddress modifier; sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
Caller-controlled address used as balance/allowance key and as the only access-control element (assert(0x0 != msg.sender)).
balanceOf[msg.sender] += (10 ** 18) unchecked mint performed before totalSupply update.
totalSupply += (10 ** 18) unchecked addition; the comment claiming it cannot overflow is false.
require(balanceOf[_to] + _value >= balanceOf[_to]) addition used as overflow guard in transfer.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= _value subtraction in transfer after the balance require.
balanceOf[_to] += _value addition in transfer.
require(balanceOf[_to] + _value >= balanceOf[_to]) overflow guard in transferFrom.
balanceOf[_to] += _value addition in transferFrom.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value subtraction in transferFrom.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value subtraction in transferFrom.
Loop emitting 100 Transfer(0xB6eD7644C69416d67B522e20bC294A9a9B405B31, msg.sender, 10**18) events with no real token movement; fabricated logs from a hardcoded address (log spoofing / phishing).
allowance[msg.sender][_spender] = _value direct overwrite; classic approve front-running race condition.
Caller-supplied hate reason string hashed into the claim key.
uint keccak256(bytes(reason)) used as the ZEROxBTCHaters key.
Loop counter 0..99 controlling the 100 fake Transfer emissions.
Recipient address parameter of transfer.
Amount parameter of transfer.
Source address parameter of transferFrom.
Recipient address parameter of transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transferFrom.
Spender address parameter of approve.
Allowance amount parameter of approve.

edges.reason: IHate0xBTC executes the unchecked balanceOf[msg.sender] += 10**18 mint.
IHate0xBTC executes the unchecked totalSupply += 10**18 addition.
IHate0xBTC contains the 100-iteration loop emitting fabricated Transfer events.
transfer performs the balanceOf[_to] + _value overflow guard.
transfer performs balanceOf[msg.sender] -= _value.
transfer performs balanceOf[_to] += _value.
transferFrom performs the balanceOf[_to] + _value overflow guard.
transferFrom performs balanceOf[_to] += _value.
transferFrom performs balanceOf[_from] -= _value.
transferFrom performs allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value.
approve performs the allowance overwrite that enables the front-running race.
msg.sender is the only caller identity used to grant IHate0xBTC rewards.
msg.sender is validated by validAddress and used for balance checks in transfer.
msg.sender is validated by validAddress and used for allowance checks in transferFrom.
msg.sender is validated by validAddress and used as allowance owner in approve.
msg.sender is the key credited in balanceOf[msg.sender] += 10**18.
msg.sender is passed as the _to argument of each fabricated Transfer event.
balanceOf mapping state is written by the IHate0xBTC mint.
balanceOf[_to] is read in the transfer overflow guard.
balanceOf[msg.sender] is read and decreased in transfer.
balanceOf[_to] is increased in transfer.
balanceOf[_to] and balanceOf[_from] are read in the transferFrom guard.
balanceOf[_to] is increased in transferFrom.
balanceOf[_from] is decreased in transferFrom.
IHate0xBTC mint writes the new balance back into balanceOf.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] is read to authorize the transferFrom amount.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] is decreased in transferFrom.
allowance[msg.sender][_spender] is overwritten by approve.
ZEROxBTCHaters hash flag is read and set to gate the IHate0xBTC claim.
totalSupply is read and increased by the IHate0xBTC mint accounting.
The unchecked sum is written back into totalSupply.
approve writes the new value into the allowance mapping.
_to indexes balanceOf in the transfer overflow guard.
_to indexes balanceOf in the recipient credit of transfer.
_value is summed with balanceOf[_to] in the transfer guard.
_value is subtracted from the sender balance in transfer.
_value is added to the recipient balance in transfer.
_from indexes balanceOf and allowance in the transferFrom guards.
_from indexes the debited balance in transferFrom.
_from indexes the allowance owner debited in transferFrom.
_to indexes balanceOf in the transferFrom overflow guard.
_to indexes the credited balance in transferFrom.
_value is summed with balanceOf[_to] in the transferFrom guard.
_value is added to the recipient balance in transferFrom.
_value is subtracted from the source balance in transferFrom.
_value is subtracted from the spender allowance in transferFrom.
_spender is the allowance key written by approve.
_value is the allowance amount written by approve.
reason string is keccak256-hashed into the local hash value.
Caller-supplied reason parameter feeds IHate0xBTC as the mined input.
Local hash value drives the ZEROxBTCHaters lookup and claim branch in IHate0xBTC.
Loop counter i bounds the 100-iteration fake Transfer emission loop.

normalization_plan.reason: The reason parameter has no independent identity outside the IHate0xBTC claim flow and should be folded into its owning function node.
The keccak256 local variable exists only to index ZEROxBTCHaters inside IHate0xBTC and should be merged into the function.
The loop counter only bounds the emission loop inside IHate0xBTC and carries no standalone semantics.
Recipient address is used exclusively by the transfer function and is normalized into it.
Amount parameter is used exclusively by the transfer arithmetic operations and is normalized into the function.
Source address is used only within transferFrom and is normalized into it.
Recipient address is used only within transferFrom and is normalized into it.
Amount parameter is used only by transferFrom arithmetic and is normalized into the function.
Spender address is used solely as the approve allowance key and is normalized into the function.
Allowance amount parameter is used solely by approve and is normalized into the function.
